column1: # Brazilian Portuguese (pt-br) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Brazilian Portuguese video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table
# or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands use the infinitive
# ("Salvar como…"), instructions use the polite imperative ("Selecione um clipe…"), and labels use
# sentence case. Product, format and technology names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS,
# EDL, AAF…) keep their spelling; decimals in prose use a comma ("29,97 fps"). This catalog has the
# same entries as `es.tsv`; strings added later show in English
# until they are translated. A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = clipe, track = faixa, sequence = sequência, timeline = linha do tempo, bin = pasta,
# playhead = cursor de reprodução, In/Out = entrada / saída, marker = marcador, keyframe =
# quadro-chave, frame = quadro, frame hold = quadro congelado, edit point = ponto de edição, panel =
# painel, workspace = área de trabalho, render = renderizar, preset = predefinição, captions =
# legendas, voice-over = narração, trim = aparar (aparagem), ripple = em cascata, roll = rolante,
# slip / slide = deslizar conteúdo / deslizar clipe, overwrite = sobrescrever, wipe = cortina,
# dissolve = dissolução, scopes = escopos, highlights = realces, offline = offline, legacy = legado,
# preferences = Preferências, settings = configurações.
